# Support & Troubleshooting — CQM2

## Getting Help

1. **Documentation & Architecture**:
   - Interactive 13-Chapter Manual: `https://0thernes.github.io/CQM2/bible.html`
   - Operational Runbook: [`docs/RUNBOOK.md`](../docs/RUNBOOK.md)
   - OpenAPI 3.1.0 Contract: [`docs/openapi.json`](../docs/openapi.json)
2. **Reproducible Bug Reports**:
   - Open an issue using the structured Bug Report template at `https://github.com/0thernes/CQM2/issues/new/choose` and include your `?seed=` parameter, OS, browser, and silicon topology.
3. **Security Disclosures**:
   - Never file security vulnerabilities publicly; follow [`.github/SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md) (`0_0@0thernes.art`).
